description_en: Creates a cloud application service instance
description_zh: 调用CreateRenderingInstance创建一个云应用服务实例
name: CreateRenderingInstance

parameters.help_en:
The specification of the cloud application service instance.

If the specification belongs to the crs.cp.* series, the billing method can be subscription or pay-as-you-go.
If the specification belongs to the crs.vm.* series, the billing method can be subscription or pay-as-you-go.
For all other series, only the subscription billing method is supported
parameters.help_zh:
云应用服务实例规格

规格为crs.cp.*系列，付费方式可选择预付费或者后付费。
规格为crs.vm.*系列，付费方式可选择预付费或者后付费。
其它剩余系列，付费方式只支持预付费
parameters.name: rendering_spec

fields.help_en: The IP address of the client
fields.name: client_ip

parameters.help_en: The maximum bandwidth. Unit: Mbit/s. Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh: 最大带宽，单位 Mbps，默认值10
parameters.name: internet_max_bandwidth

parameters.help_en:
This parameter is valid only when `InstanceChargeType` is set to `PrePaid` (subscription).

Specifies whether to enable auto-renewal. Valid values:
true: Enabled.
false: Disabled
parameters.help_zh:
此值仅在 `InstanceChargeType` 为 `PrePaid`（包年包月）时有效。

开启或关闭自动续费，取值：
true：开启。
false：关闭
parameters.name: auto_renew

parameters.help_en:
This parameter is valid only when `InstanceChargeType` is set to `PrePaid` (subscription).

The subscription duration. Valid values (Note: If you select 12, it is converted to one year. For other values, the unit is months):

1 (default)
2
3
4
5
6
7
8
9
12
parameters.help_zh:
此值仅在 `InstanceChargeType` 为 `PrePaid`（包年包月）时有效。

包年包月的时长。取值范围（注：当选12的时候会被换算为一年，其余以月为周期单位）：

1（默认）
2
3
4
5
6
7
8
9
12
parameters.name: period

parameters.help_en:
The billing method of the instance. Valid values:

PrePaid (default): subscription.
PostPaid: pay-as-you-go
parameters.help_zh:
实例的付费方式，取值范围：

PrePaid（默认）：预付费包年包月。
PostPaid：后付费按量付费
parameters.name: instance_charge_type

parameters.help_en:
Only one Billable methods is supported. If Billable methods already exist, the new value is invalid by default, and the existing Billable methods prevail. Note that this parameter is required when you purchase the instance for the first time.

The network billing type. Valid values:
95BandwidthByMonth: monthly 95th percentile bandwidth
parameters.help_zh:
只能有一种计费方式，如果已存在计费方式，则新值默认无效，以已存在的为准。注意用户第一次购买的时候该字段必填。

网络计费类型，取值：
95BandwidthByMonth：月95峰值带宽
parameters.name: internet_charge_type

parameters.help_en: The cloud storage capacity used by the cloud application service instance. Note: This refers to cloud storage, not local storage
parameters.help_zh: 云应用服务实例使用云存储容量（注：非本地存储）
parameters.name: storage_size

parameters.help_en:
This parameter is valid only when `InstanceChargeType` is set to `PostPaid` (pay-as-you-go).

The billing cycle. Valid values:

Hour: hourly
parameters.help_zh:
此值仅在 `InstanceChargeType` 为 `PostPaid`（按量付费）时有效。

计费类型，取值范围：

Hour：小时
parameters.name: instance_billing_cycle

parameters.help_en:
Keep the default value unless you have special requirements. If you have special requirements, contact technical support to confirm the parameters before you specify them.

The attribute information
parameters.help_zh:
非特殊需求，请保持默认值。有特殊需求的客户，请沟通确认后填写相关参数。

属性信息
parameters.name: attributes

RenderingInstanceId.description_en: The instance ID of the cloud application service
